<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

"Turn the proven build substrate into pipelines (Jordan agreements 2026-08-26): a Linux gate on every main push (checks + tests with pgvector service, fake provider, no endpoints/secrets); release-please rolling release PR (conventional commits now binding) cut on merge; release builds = Linux+Windows in the plan-002 build container + mac BUILT on a macOS runner but never gated (Windows produced-not-run, both deferred-validation stances recorded honestly in release notes); a curl installer (+ PowerShell twin) pulling the latest GitHub Release; Dependabot on cargo+actions. gh CLI is authed for watching runs."

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- Every main push proves the tree on Linux exactly as harness checks does locally, incl. store tests against a pgvector service container.
- Merging the release PR produces a semver GitHub Release carrying mac(arm64+x64)/linux(arm64+x64, gnu+musl)/windows(x64) binaries named by target triple.
- One-line install works on mac and linux from the README (windows script present, validated later).
- Dependabot keeps cargo + actions patched (req 48).

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Running/validating windows binaries (deferred; procedure documented in ox's strategy doc).
- Gating on macOS runners (mac builds release-only; Linux is the only checking platform).
- PR-based workflows/branch protection (we work on main; revisit at first PR).
- Publishing to crates.io/homebrew/winget (later; GitHub Releases only).

<a id="execution-guardrails"></a>

## Execution Guardrails

- CI runs plain cargo test ONLY - keyed/slow tiers stay out; no provider secrets exist in Actions.
- Toolchain comes from rust-toolchain.toml - never a hardcoded version in workflows.
- Conventional commits binding (ruling 2026-08-26 item 6).
- Release notes state deferred-validation honestly (mac unvalidated-by-CI, windows unexecuted).
- Shared-tree commit discipline unchanged; workflows land as normal scoped commits.
